description: Blargg read_joy3 (4 ROMs), rebuilt on blargg's modern shell (instr_test-v5/source/common) with the suite's own DMC-sync code (common/sync_dmc.s); patches/ make each ROM report its result over the $401E VELOCE-RESULT/1 port (tests/roms-src/include/veloce-blargg.inc). None of upstream's four shipped binaries (test_buttons included) writes the $6000 block: all four use the suite's older console+serial shell (NES-3).
license: blargg (Shay Green) test code; upstream read_joy3/source/readme.txt carries no licence statement (plan section 8 treats blargg's NES test ROMs as freely usable). Only Veloce's patch is committed; sources are fetched at the pinned SHA.
golden_gate_reason: Rebuilt on purpose against a different shell than the one upstream's binary was built with (instr_test-v5/source/common, blargg's modern shell with text_out.s, instead of this suite's own older console+serial common/), so the result cannot be byte-identical by construction. For the record, the unmodified source built against its OWN common/ with the same toolchain is the same size as upstream's shipped ROM but not byte-identical either (72-99 bytes differ per ROM, first divergence at file offset 0x6084-0x6370) -- the same '--feature force_range' situation tests/roms-src/nes/cpu_dummy_reads/PROVENANCE.md documents. Verified behaviourally instead; see PROVENANCE.md.

commands: ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o count_errors.o count_errors.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o count_errors_fast.o count_errors_fast.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o thorough_test.o thorough_test.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o test_buttons.o test_buttons.s
